$comment: Reviewed hard gzip budgets in KiB for bundled+minified ESM with optional peers externalized. These are release limits, not generated baselines; aggregate compatibility-entry ceilings include roving selection grids, projected-content isolation, light-DOM announcements, standard error chrome, focus-continuity repairs, media lifecycle state transfer, defensive value normalization, bounded rendered-data alternatives, vetoable layout transitions, iframe theme-state restoration, transitive autoloader peer metadata, and (2026-08-12) the 2026-08-12 full-sweep review remediation's cross-component :focus-visible/disabled-hover-guard/declaration-order CSS fixes and matching JSDoc, sized with headroom for the remainder of that same remediation still landing in later batches, while family, component, and percentile ceilings remain unchanged. Raised again (2026-08-12) for the same remediation's batches 4-10, which the earlier bump under-sized: beyond further cross-component CSS and JSDoc, those batches added real opt-in capability -- per-box lr-box-plot keyboard/pointer interactivity, the shared chart forced-colors encoding module used by lr-box-plot and lr-lite-chart, lr-xml-viewer host-supplied highlights, lr-context-meter's legend, lr-node-palette reordering, lr-retrieval-results custom grouping, lr-terminal compact/frame chrome, and host focus/blur/click forwarding across five media components. Aggregate compatibility entries and the two family ceilings that carry most of that work (agent-tools, retrieval) move; every per-component, percentile, and other family ceiling stays unchanged. Sized ~4% above the measured build now that this remediation is complete, rather than for further batches. The conversation family ceiling moves too (310 -> 325): it was already the tightest of the eleven, and lr-code-block/lr-markdown legitimately regained per-component messages once the default-string slice generator learned the bare-identifier `localize(key)` call shape that shared helper modules use, on top of that family's own Shiki dark-theme wiring. The button canary moves 31 -> 33 in 9.0.0 for the settable-`rel` merge: `rel` became a real reflected property plus a `resolvedRel` getter that strips `opener` and force-adds the `target`-derived guard, replacing a two-line derived getter. That change is what reclassified wa-button/sl-button/wa-breadcrumb-item/sl-breadcrumb-item from `warning-required` to migratable (warning-required 13 -> 9), so the bytes buy the library's most-used component a mechanical migration path. Kept deliberately tight -- this entry is the foreign-dependency canary, not a general growth allowance.
